fullPassage: The Four Pests Campaign was begun in 1958 by Chinese leader Mao Zedong. The purpose of the program was to get rid of four creatures that were considered harmful to people, and three of these were obvious choices: mosquitoes, flies, and rats. However, you may feel that Mao's fourthly designated pest, the sparrow, does not seem as harmful. But Mao suspected that sparrows consumed seeds planted by Chinese farmers. For this reason, the birds were included on the list, and they were targeted by the government. People were instructed to chase them away or kill them on sight. The campaign was completed successfully, making sparrows nearly extinct in China. Unfortunately, this led to severe ecological imbalance. In addition to eating seeds, sparrows also fed on locusts. With the birds gone, the locust population in China exploded. It caused farmers to lose large amounts of their grain, which resulted in a serious food famine in China.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) obvious=명백한, (B) included=포함된, (C) extinct=멸종한
det.analysis:
✅ ① obvious — included — extinct — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ② unclear(불분명한) — included — extinct: (A) 모기·파리·쥐는 누가 봐도 '명백한' 선택이므로 obvious. unclear는 반대

❌ ③ obvious — excluded(제외된) — extinct: (B) 참새가 명단에 '포함되어' 표적이 되었으므로 included. excluded는 반대

❌ ④ obvious — included — abundant(많은): (C) 캠페인으로 참새가 거의 '멸종'했으므로 extinct. abundant는 반대
det.tip: obvious(명백한) ↔ unclear(불분명한), include(포함하다) ↔ exclude(제외하다), extinct(멸종한) ↔ abundant(풍부한)

det.korean: harmful(해로운) ↔ beneficial(이로운)
det.analysis:
✅ ① beneficial(이로운) ←정답 — harmful(해로운)의 반의어

❌ ② dangerous(위험한) — harmful과 비슷한 부정적 의미(동의어 함정)

❌ ③ common(흔한) — 빈도를 나타내는 다른 의미축

❌ ④ natural(자연의) — 성질을 나타내는 다른 의미축
det.tip: harmful(해로운) ↔ beneficial(이로운). dangerous는 동의어 함정, common·natural은 다른 의미축

questions.passage: The Four Pests Campaign was begun in 1958 by Chinese leader Mao Zedong. The purpose of the program was to get rid of four creatures that were considered harmful to people, and three of these were obvious choices: mosquitoes, flies, and rats. However, you may feel that Mao's fourthly designated pest, the sparrow, does not seem as harmful. But Mao suspected that sparrows consumed seeds planted by Chinese farmers. For this reason, the birds were included on the list, and they were targeted by the government. People were instructed to chase them away or kill them on sight. The campaign was completed successfully, making sparrows nearly extinct in China. Unfortunately, this led to <u>severe</u> ecological imbalance. In addition to eating seeds, sparrows also fed on locusts. With the birds gone, the locust population in China exploded. It caused farmers to lose large amounts of their grain, which resulted in a serious food famine in China.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 severe의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: severe(심각한, 극심한) ↔ mild(가벼운, 완만한)
det.analysis:
❌ ① harsh(가혹한) — severe와 비슷한 뜻(동의어 함정)

✅ ② mild(가벼운) ←정답 — severe(심각한)의 반의어

❌ ③ sudden(갑작스러운) — 시간·속도를 나타내는 다른 의미축

❌ ④ local(지역의) — 장소를 나타내는 다른 의미축
det.tip: severe(심각한) ↔ mild(가벼운). harsh는 동의어 함정, sudden·local은 다른 의미축

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 grain이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) grain=곡물(쌀·밀 등 식량) / (B) grain=(나무의) 결, 무늬
det.analysis:
(A) grain = 곡물 — 쌀·밀 같은 '곡물'이 부족해 기근이 퍼짐

(B) grain = 결 — 나무 표면을 따라 흐르는 '결(무늬)'을 봄

따라서 (A) 곡물 — (B) 결 ←정답은 ③

①②④는 두 문맥의 의미를 잘못 짝지음
det.tip: grain: (A) 곡물(식량) vs (B) 나뭇결/무늬

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a serious shortage of food that causes many people to suffer or die"

det.korean: 많은 사람을 고통받거나 죽게 하는 심각한 식량 부족 → famine(기근)
det.analysis:
❌ ① drought(가뭄) — 물 부족 현상이지 식량 부족 자체는 아님

❌ ② harvest(수확) — 곡물을 거두는 것으로 반대 상황

❌ ③ feast(잔치) — 음식이 풍족한 상황

✅ ④ famine(기근) ←정답 — 많은 사람이 고통받거나 죽는 '심각한 식량 부족'
det.tip: a serious shortage of food(심각한 식량 부족) = famine(기근)

questions.passage: People were instructed to chase them away or kill them on sight. The campaign was completed __________ (success), making sparrows nearly extinct in China.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: success(명사) → successfully(부사): 성공적으로. 동사 completed를 꾸미는 부사 자리
det.analysis:
'The campaign was completed ____'에서 동사(completed)를 수식하는 부사가 필요

success(성공, 명사) → successfully(성공적으로, 부사)

따라서 빈칸에는 successfully
det.tip: 명사 success → 부사 successfully: 동사를 꾸미면 부사

questions.passage: The Four Pests Campaign was begun in 1958 by Chinese leader Mao Zedong. The purpose of the program was to get rid of four creatures that were __________ (consider) harmful to people.

det.korean: consider(동사) → considered(과거분사): 'were ____'는 be동사 뒤 과거분사가 오는 수동태 자리
det.analysis:
'four creatures that were ____ harmful'에서 be동사(were) 뒤 과거분사가 오는 수동태 자리

따라서 빈칸에는 considered (~로 여겨지는)
det.tip: be + p.p. 수동태: consider → were considered(여겨졌다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답: fed on locusts(메뚜기를 먹었다). 새가 사라지자 메뚜기가 급증한 것으로 보아 참새가 메뚜기를 잡아먹었음을 알 수 있음
det.analysis:

❌ ② built large nests(큰 둥지를 지었다) — 메뚜기 급증과 인과관계 없음

❌ ③ migrated far away(멀리 이동했다) — 문맥과 무관

❌ ④ attacked the farmers(농부를 공격했다) — 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: birds gone → locust population exploded(새가 사라지자 메뚜기 급증) → 참새가 메뚜기를 먹었음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답: led to severe ecological imbalance(심각한 생태 불균형을 초래했다). Unfortunately 뒤 부정적 결과이며, 이어서 메뚜기 급증·기근이 설명됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① solved the food shortage(식량 부족을 해결했다) — 결과적으로 기근이 왔으므로 반대

✅ ② led to severe ecological imbalance(심각한 생태 불균형을 초래했다) ←정답 — 앞의 'Unfortunately(불행히도)'와 뒤의 메뚜기 급증·기근 설명이 '생태 불균형'이라는 부정적 결과를 가리킴

❌ ③ protected the local birds(토착 새를 보호했다) — 참새가 멸종했으므로 반대
